description: Read the current page's published title, headings and structured content, or one section selected by its heading anchor. Returns the canonical URL and explicit truncation information. Reads only the current rendered page; does not fetch other articles.

pagePath.description: Canonical GoVisit page path supplying this tool's published context; no origin, query or fragment.

section.description: Optional heading anchor identifying one published section.

name: get_documentation_page
title: Read documentation page
